en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a broad market square in a European town. Historic multi‑storey buildings line both sides of the square, with a tall clock‑towered town hall dominating the right side. There are shopfronts with awnings, a few parked cars and bicycles, and two people standing near a central lamppost. Trees and additional houses appear in the background. The caption at the bottom reads "Ehrenfriedersdorf i. Erzgeb. Markt" and one shop sign reads "OTTO SCHIFFNER Buchbinderei".
